856-4321-7396-8249.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-7396-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

4068-4289-4770-6090.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
4068-4289-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3508-4879-6922.easyPrerequisites:
There is at least one card in your library.
You control a destructible land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
3508-4879-6922.description:
Pay {1}{U} to turn Coveted Falcon face up, drawing a card and causing target opponent to gain control of Price of Glory.
During an opponent's turn, activate any land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Price of Glory triggers, destroying the land.
Sacred Ground triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

728-3593-4359-4871.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Garna.
When Garna dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Resolve the Garna trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
728-3593-4359-4871.notes: You can repeat this loop with any number of additional creatures. This will require the desired creatures to either be on the battlefield already, or to be in your hand with an additional {R} available for each creature. Simply play all other creatures with Sneak Attack before Garna, and then make sure to sacrifice them all for {R} before resolving Garna's trigger.

4247-5035-5104.description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B} and choosing to pay any amount of life, creating that many 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a Rat.
When the Rat dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 2 as able.
4247-5035-5104.notes: It's recommended to pay as much life as possible to maximize the amount of lifeloss. If an opponent happens to pay life during casting Plague of Vermin, those additional Rats can also be sacrificed.

1545-1981-2415-4247.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1545-1981-2415-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

799-1887-3582.easyPrerequisites: Kaya must be able to survive one turn cycle, or you control an additional legendary creature or planeswalker.
799-1887-3582.description:
Cast Kaya the Inexorable by paying {3}{W}{B}, causing her to enter with ten loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate Kaya's last ability by removing seven loyalty counters, getting her emblem.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, the emblem triggers, allowing you to cast Karn's Temporal Sundering from hand, graveyard, or exile without paying its mana cost, gaining an extra turn after this one.
Repeat step 3 each turn.

2021-2060-2313-5902.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

431-1308-3129-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1308-3129-7824.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3122-4865.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3122-4865.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vesuvan Shapeshifter and Undercover Operative each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Undercover Operative trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3122-4865.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1987-3075-4863.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-3075-4863.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters
1987-3075-4863.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3075-4863.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

850-876-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.
850-876-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Overgrown Battlement.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Overgrown Battlement.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Overgrown Battlement.
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Overgrown Battlement.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Overgrown Battlement.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Overgrown Battlement from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

876-3291-7070.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 2.
876-3291-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Karametra's Acolyte.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Karametra's Acolyte.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Karametra's Acolyte.
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Karametra's Acolyte.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Karametra's Acolyte.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

193-957-2369-4423.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Aminatou's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Aminatou's second ability by removing a loyalty counter on it, blinking Mystic Sanctuary.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
Repeat during your second extra turn
193-957-2369-4423.notes: Mystic Sanctuary can be tapped for mana before casting Time Stretch if it's able to do so.

4188-7500.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
4188-7500.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least six mana of any color
Activate Ringing Strike Mastery by paying {5}, untapping Accomplished Alchemist.
Repeat.

2957-4997-7414.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2957-4997-7414.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Pensive Professor to become a Merfolk or Knight until end of turn.
Draw a card.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pensive Professor.
Pensive Professor triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

423-1313-1437-5233.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-1313-1437-5233.description:
Cast Arboreal Grazer by paying {G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Arboreal Grazer spell three times.
Resolve the first Arboreal Grazer copy.
The Arboreal Grazer token enters the battlefield, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-7013-7290.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
1978-7013-7290.description:
Animate White Lotus Tile using Does Machines.
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat from step 2.

1687-2292-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2292-6662-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2292-2403-5220-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Axonil, Deepest Might // Temple of Power

2868-5551-6797.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
2868-5551-6797.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Axonil that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Axonil that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat from step 4.

1274-1818-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1818-3197.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

228-3983-4871-6291.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness equal to 1.
228-3983-4871-6291.description:
Activate Skullclamp by paying {1}, attaching it to a creature with toughness equal to 1.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness, triggering Skullclamp and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1445-4871-5256-5477.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-5256-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

628-2018-2921.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that is not a Human and does not have flying.
628-2018-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers if it didn't have a +1/+1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if the creature didn't have flying.
Resolve the undying trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if the creature is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

2511-4053--73.notablePrerequisites: If a persist creature is used, it does not have a -1/-1 counter on it. Otherwise, if an undying creature is used, it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
2511-4053--73.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the persist or undying creature.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
2511-4053--73.notes: If you wish to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Bloodflow Connoisseur, instead do not resolve its abilities, and then remove Solemnity from the battlefield. Then, resolve the abilities to get the +1/+1 counters.

586-2510-5147-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
586-2510-5147-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1018-4872-5626.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} the first turn, with {5}{U}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
1018-4872-5626.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less.
1018-4872-5626.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 3 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Skullwinder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Skullwinder, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

717-1379-1742-4798.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil, adding {B}.
Bone Miser triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, causing you to return Ovalchase Daredevil to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

215-1701-2557-4050-5176.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six Islands.
215-1701-2557-4050-5176.description:
Cast Spire Golem by paying {0}.
Radagast triggers, creating two 3/3 Beast creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Beasts, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Spire Golem from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1392-2034-4772-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Goblin.
1392-2034-4772-4871.description:
Activate Weirding Shaman by paying {3}{B} and sacrificing a Goblin.
The Goblin dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Weirding Shaman ability, creating four 1/1 Goblin Rogue creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Goblin Rogue creature token, adding {C}{C}.
The Goblin Rogue dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

1157-1806-2034-2382.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Mimic Vat triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

3510-3703-4050.notablePrerequisites: An additional land card in hand.
3510-3703-4050.description:
Play a land.
Sporemound triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling token that is also a Forest.
Repeat step 2 any number of times.
Activate Phyrexian Altar any number of times by sacrificing Sporemound and any number of other creatures, adding any amount of colored mana.
